description: This file 'remove_actions.php' is responsible for removing access control list (ACL) actions for certain modules in the SuiteCRM system, specifically when the current user is an administrator. It checks for modules with missing or invalid bean files and removes their ACLs, printing messages to indicate actions taken.

classes.name: ACLAction
classes.description: Class responsible for managing access control list actions, providing methods to get default actions and remove actions for specific modules.

methods.name: ACLAction::getDefaultActions
methods.description: Returns an array of default ACL action objects available in the system.

methods.name: ACLAction::removeActions
methods.description: Removes ACL actions for the specified module category.

methods.name: is_admin
methods.description: Checks if the current user has administrative privileges.
